title: Agent traits
description: The five trait slots of one swarm agent. They drive the rendered SVG and the agent's behaviour.

temperament.title: Temperament
temperament.description: Draws the palette: cool is greys and blues, neon clashes, warm is oranges, muted is green and sepia.

role.title: Role
role.description: Draws the glyph: observer wears a monocle, trickster a jester cap, connector an antenna and speech bubble, auditor a magnifier.

risk.title: Risk
risk.description: Draws the background: low is sparse dots, high is a zigzag, mid is concentric waves, wary is a grid.

voice.title: Voice
voice.description: Draws the face: dry is half-closed eyes, loud is a wide grin, open is a smile, flat is a raised brow and a flat mouth.

memory_depth.title: Memory depth
memory_depth.description: Draws the rings. 1 at mint, +1 per summary, capped at 12 so the SVG size stays bounded.
